message:
Google Photos has no organization-wide export, so this one runs per user: each user in scope creates their own Takeout with only Google Photos selected.

- **We pull it**, Instructions: takeout.google.com → Deselect all → tick Google Photos → All photo albums included → Next step → Delivery: Add to Drive → .zip → 50 GB → Create export, then wait for the mail saying the Takeout folder has landed in your Drive. Then run rclone authorize "drive" on your own machine, sign in as that same Google account and grant read access on the consent screen, and send us the token JSON it prints along with the Drive folder link by secure means, never plaintext email, chat or a ticket.

Let me know if you have any questions about the rclone process!
notes: There is no organization-wide Google Photos export; every user in scope must run their own Photos-only Takeout.
Takeout preparation time scales with library size, and the export must land in Drive before the pull can start.
